title: 实验记录本（国内版）
source_doc: course/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/09_APB - Laboratory Notebooks.md
author_source: project/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/09_APB - Laboratory Notebooks（国内版）/src.py

points.S1: 如实记录，守住科研诚信
points.S4: 原始记录归单位，按规定保存

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一本黑色硬皮记录本，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a plain black hardcover lab notebook with a blank cover and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验记录本。

shots.scene: 钢笔、页码、签名、斜线四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a fountain pen, a page with a number corner, a signature line, and a page with a diagonal slash. No people.
shots.narration: 写得清、标得全、改得明、存得好。

shots.scene: 阿杰在一张便签纸上用铅笔记数据
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scribbles numbers with a pencil on a small sticky note at the lab bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完实验，把数据记在便签上。

shots.scene: 阿杰用橡皮擦掉一个数字，重写了一个
shots.prompt_en: The young male student erases a number on the sticky note and writes a different one.
shots.narration: 数据不好看，他擦掉重写了一个。

shots.scene: 小研拿着记录本走来，指着便签摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a lab notebook and shakes her head at the sticky note.
shots.narration: 小研摇头：原始数据，不能这样记。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 记录本，是实验的身份证。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着空白笔记本，旁边是暂停、回放图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank notebook and a pen, next to pause and replay icons.
shots.narration: 边看边记，需要时暂停回看。

shots.scene: 一个活页夹和一本硬皮记录本并排
shots.prompt_en: A ring binder and a bound hardcover notebook side by side on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 以前用活页夹整理资料，

shots.scene: 阿杰接过一本新的硬皮记录本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student receives a new bound hardcover notebook from the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 这门课，还要用一本实验记录本。

shots.scene: 记录本封面和内页图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a notebook cover and an open notebook page with blank lines. No people.
shots.narration: 怎样建立，怎样书写，一起来看。

shots.scene: 空白活动单和空白规范文件并排
shots.prompt_en: A blank activity sheet and a blank guidelines document side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 照着活动单和记录规范，一步步来。

shots.scene: 记录本上有天平图标，象征正式文件
shots.prompt_en: A notebook icon with a small scale-of-justice icon on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 记录本是正式的科学文件，

shots.scene: 实验台上的各种操作图标都指向记录本
shots.prompt_en: Icons of pipetting, weighing and heating with arrows all pointing into one notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里做的事，都要记下来。

shots.scene: 钢笔打勾，铅笔打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a pen with a green check and a pencil with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一律用笔写，不用铅笔，

shots.scene: 整齐清楚的字迹页面
shots.prompt_en: An open notebook page with neat, evenly spaced handwriting lines, no readable text. No people.
shots.narration: 字迹清楚，让别人能照着做。

shots.scene: 橡皮、涂改液图标打叉，文字中间划一条线打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eraser and a correction fluid bottle crossed out with a red X, next to a line of text with a single strike-through line and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 写错了不擦不涂，划一条线。

shots.scene: 胶棒打勾，胶带和订书钉打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a glue stick with a green check, tape and a stapler with red X marks, next to a small chart pasted on a page. No people.
shots.narration: 图表照片贴在对应页，用胶棒。

shots.scene: 公制单位图标打勾，乱缩写打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of metric unit symbols with a green check and a scribbled abbreviation crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不跳页，除单位外少用缩写。

shots.scene: 记录本前几页是目录页
shots.prompt_en: An open notebook showing the first pages as a table of contents with blank rows. No people.
shots.narration: 先建目录：前几页留给目录，

shots.scene: 目录一行里有题目、日期、页码三个格
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a table of contents row with three blank cells marked by icons: a title, a calendar and a page number. No people.
shots.narration: 每个实验登记题目、开始日期和起始页。

shots.scene: 翻到第一个实验页
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns the notebook to the first experiment page after the contents pages.
shots.narration: 第一个实验，从目录后面接着写。

shots.scene: 记录页上五个位置亮起：页码、题目、日期、签名、核验
shots.prompt_en: A notebook page with five highlighted spots: page number corner, title line, date box, signature line and a second initials box. No people.
shots.narration: 每一页都要有页码、题目、日期，

shots.scene: 阿杰签名，小研在旁边签核验
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs the bottom of a notebook page, and the female graduate student adds her initials as the witness.
shots.narration: 本人签名，再请同学核验签字。

shots.scene: 目的、材料、用量、步骤四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a target, a box of lab materials, a measuring cylinder and a numbered list. No people.
shots.narration: 写清目的、材料、用量和步骤，

shots.scene: 按规程做的步骤也写下来
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank protocol sheet with an arrow into a notebook page. No people.
shots.narration: 照着现成规程做，也要写下来。

shots.scene: 温度计、时钟、反应气泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a thermometer, a clock and a bubbling flask. No people.
shots.narration: 记下反应现象、条件和环境因素。

shots.scene: 结果、分析、结论三个格子
shots.prompt_en: Three blank boxes in a row labeled by icons: a bar chart, a magnifying glass and a flag. No people.
shots.narration: 最后写结果、分析和结论。

shots.scene: 日历上跨了好几天的实验
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with an experiment bar spanning several days. No people.
shots.narration: 实验常常要做好几次课、写好几页。

shots.scene: 页面右下角高亮一个箭头和页码框
shots.prompt_en: A notebook page with its bottom right corner highlighted, showing an arrow and a blank page number box. No people.
shots.narration: 没写完，在右下角写“转第几页”，

shots.scene: 续页左上角高亮一个箭头和页码框
shots.prompt_en: A notebook page with its top left corner highlighted, showing an incoming arrow and a blank page number box. No people.
shots.narration: 续页左上角写“接第几页”。

shots.scene: 两个实验的页面交错排列，箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: A row of notebook pages of two experiments in different colors, interleaved and linked by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 中间夹着别的实验，也不会乱。

shots.scene: 整页空白的页面被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An entirely blank notebook page crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不留整页空白。

shots.scene: 没写满的页面空白处画了一条斜线，旁边签名
shots.prompt_en: A half-filled notebook page with a diagonal line drawn through the empty part, a signature line and date box beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 没写满，空白处画斜线，签名注日期。

shots.scene: 工厂实验室里，老周翻看记录本
shots.prompt_en: The older man in a lab coat reviews a notebook in a tidy industrial lab.
shots.narration: 在企业，记录本记的是精确的规程和数据。

shots.scene: 两个人按同一本记录做出相同结果
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student follows an open notebook step by step and gets the same bar chart result shown in the notebook.
shots.narration: 记得准，自己和别人都能重复验证。

shots.scene: 记录本箭头指向论文和报告
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a notebook with arrows to a blank journal article and a blank report. No people.
shots.narration: 论文和报告的原始数据，来自记录本。

shots.scene: 记录本和带印章的证书图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a notebook beside a blank certificate with a seal. No people.
shots.narration: 它还能证明发明和专利。

shots.scene: 阿杰独自设计实验，身边是记录本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student plans his own experiment at a desk with his lab notebook open.
shots.narration: 课程最后，要做一项独立探究，

shots.scene: 记录本放在中央，周围是实验图标
shots.prompt_en: A notebook in the center surrounded by small experiment icons. No people.
shots.narration: 记录本就是探究的核心。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评分表看记录本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a student notebook with a blank grading table beside it.
shots.narration: 老师会按评分表给记录本反馈：

shots.scene: 组织、页码、内容、核验四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a tidy folder, a page number, a list and a pair of signatures. No people.
shots.narration: 看组织、页码、内容和核验。

shots.scene: 阿杰带着规范和评分表去问老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student brings a blank guidelines sheet and grading table to ask the safety administrator a question.
shots.narration: 有疑问，带着规范和评分表来问。

shots.section_title: 如实记录，守住科研诚信
shots.scene: 记录本上的数据被橡皮擦改的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a notebook number being erased and rewritten, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 原始数据，只能如实记录。
overlay: 如实记录，守住科研诚信

shots.section_title: 如实记录，守住科研诚信
shots.scene: 编造、篡改两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a hand inventing numbers from nothing, and scissors cutting a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 不编造，不篡改，不挑着记。

shots.section_title: 如实记录，守住科研诚信
shots.scene: 不理想的数据点也写在本上，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: A chart in a notebook with one odd data point clearly recorded and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 失败和异常结果，也要写下来。

shots.section_title: 如实记录，守住科研诚信
shots.scene: 老周和阿杰面对面谈话
shots.prompt_en: The older man talks seriously with the young male student at a desk, an open notebook between them.
shots.narration: 数据造假是科研失信，后果严重。

shots.section_title: 如实记录，守住科研诚信
shots.scene: 空白文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A blank folder labeled only with a shield icon on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 按国家和学校的科研诚信规定处理。

shots.scene: 记录页上画着危险标志的一栏
shots.prompt_en: A notebook page with a column of small hazard pictograms beside the materials list. No people.
shots.narration: 用了哪些危险试剂，记下来；

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、通风柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, gloves and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 采取了哪些防护，记下来；

shots.scene: 风险评估表图标和记录本相连
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank risk assessment form linked to a notebook page. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估的结论，记下来。

shots.scene: 小研在记录本上写下溅洒和处理经过
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in her notebook after a small spill was cleaned up, a spill kit nearby.
shots.narration: 出现异常和事故，如实记并报告。

shots.scene: 戴着污染手套在记录本上写字的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stained gloved hand writing in a notebook, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别戴着污染的手套写记录。

shots.scene: 记录本放在远离试剂和水槽的干净台面上
shots.prompt_en: A notebook placed on a clean desk area away from reagent bottles and the sink. No people.
shots.narration: 记录本放在干净、不会溅到的地方。

shots.scene: 生物安全实验室门上的生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door with a biohazard warning sign and a blank notice beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 进生物安全实验室，按那里的规定记录。

shots.section_title: 原始记录归单位，按规定保存
shots.scene: 记录本放进实验室带锁的档案柜
shots.prompt_en: A row of lab notebooks placed into a lockable filing cabinet in the lab. No people.
shots.narration: 原始记录属于单位，要按规定保存。
overlay: 原始记录归单位，按规定保存

shots.section_title: 原始记录归单位，按规定保存
shots.scene: 毕业生把记录本交给老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands his completed lab notebook to the older man.
shots.narration: 离开实验室时交回，不能带走或销毁。

shots.section_title: 原始记录归单位，按规定保存
shots.scene: 手机拍记录本发到网上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a phone photographing a notebook page and sharing it online, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不随意拍照外传。

shots.section_title: 原始记录归单位，按规定保存
shots.scene: 电脑和移动硬盘之间的同步箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a computer and an external drive with sync arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 电子数据，按规定及时备份。

shots.scene: 试剂柜旁边挂着空白的领用登记本
shots.prompt_en: A reagent cabinet with a blank sign-out logbook hanging beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 危险化学品的领用，要登记，

shots.scene: 仪器旁边的使用登记本
shots.prompt_en: A blank equipment usage logbook next to an incubator. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器使用、安全检查，都要记录。

shots.scene: 王老师翻看台账，点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank logbook and nods.
shots.narration: 台账和记录本一样，如实、及时。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现钢笔、页码、签名图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a pen, a page number and a signature.
shots.narration: 用笔写，编页码，每页签名核验。

shots.scene: 目录、跨页箭头、斜线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a table of contents, linking arrows between pages and a diagonal slash on a page. No people.
shots.narration: 有目录，标转接，空白画斜线。

shots.scene: 如实记录的打勾图标，涂改打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons: an honest data page with a green check, and an erased page with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 如实记录，划线更正，不涂不改。

shots.scene: 危险标志、档案柜、台账图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of hazard pictograms, a lockable filing cabinet and a logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 记下安全信息，按规定保存。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着记录本挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hugs a plain black lab notebook and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 认真记录，诚信科研，下次见！
